$comment: The index of the 10110 TastesLike Plaza doc set. This file answers 'which document wins' in machine-readable form. Governed by specs/meta/META-SPEC.md; enforced by scripts/validate_specs.py. Every markdown file under docs/, specs/, Docs/, and the root README.md must appear in exactly one of `documents` or `exempt`.

documents.note: The constitution. Defines the tier ladder, the authority vocabulary, the conflict protocol, and the binding rules for agents.
Drives the concept axis. Names STORYBOARD-W1 as the sole origin of concept decisions, defines the dual-layer scene contract, and holds the SB-nn scene index.
Every locked decision, with a stable D-nnn id and a named origin document. What the 'cite the source doc' rule points at.
Drives v0.2.5 development. Deliverables, the traceability chain, the open-conflict register, and the exit criteria to v1.0.
Entry point to the meta layer. Derived; never authoritative.
The heart. The ONLY document permitted to originate concept and narrative decisions. Edits require human sign-off.
documents.enforcement_na_reason: Concept and narrative only. Defines what the world IS; asserts nothing about what the code, board or tooling currently does.

documents.note: Promoted /plan-ceo-review output, 2026-04-27. Authoritative for HOW to build. The 2.5D pivot lives here.

Authoritative for platform and repository decisions that outlive the current frontend: engine, bridge transport, agent data layer, licence, submodule and merge policy. Created in v0.2.7 to give the eight decisions PROJECT-OVERVIEW was wrongly named as originating an entitled home (issue #11, conflict 4.8).
Canonical public statement of what and why. Reconciles the concept and implementation axes; originates neither. Its `decides` list was removed in v0.2.7 -- see PLATFORM-DECISIONS.
Authoritative for the department to floor to colour mapping only. Agent counts and role lists derive from the claude-code-tresor submodule.

Taxonomy authority for Atlassian identifiers (D-026). The single origin of every Jira key, Confluence space and page id this repo uses. Since PLZG-109, both Python scripts read their coordinates from the environment and hold none; no script is a second SOURCE for one -- the 'scripts are the other legitimate copy' clause was retired with D-026's rationale in PLZG-137. Keys still APPEAR in prose elsewhere (guides cite them); what D-026 forbids is another document originating one.
M1 to M8 milestone structure. Authoritative for sequencing.
Historical checklist from early planning. Progress state lives in CLAUDE.md and git history.
Branching policy. Corrected in v0.2.6 to describe this repo: the aspirational workflows and branch-protection rules are fenced in a dedicated 'Intended, not yet active' section.
One page, derived, regenerable. Never authoritative - if it disagrees with anything, it is wrong.

Folder index for specs/.

Research input. Its normative content was promoted into the meta layer; its section 01.3 fabricated a 14-scene spine that contradicts STORYBOARD-W1 and is superseded by CONCEPT-DRIVER. Retained for findings, rationale, and citations.
Migration signpost left behind when Docs/files/00-04 were relocated in PR #5. Retained so old links land somewhere useful.

Executable context for PLZG Sprint 2 (board 169, sprint 44, 2026-07-30 to 2026-08-13). Locks the delivery decisions reached in the 2026-07-30 grill so they survive the session that produced them. Derives from ROADMAP and DELIVERY-COORDINATES; originates time-boxed delivery policy under D-028 -- WIP limits, retry budgets, review gates, forecast blackouts -- which expires with the sprint and is deliberately not registered as a D-nnn.

Executable context for Sprint 3. Follows up Sprint 2's close and plans the enforcement-axis amendment (D-027) plus the delivery authority that closes open conflict 4.10 (D-028). Declared 'derived' until T7: D-028 created 'delivery' at T1 with META-SPEC as its origin, but the frontmatter schema rejected the value until T2 extended the enum, so it was undeclarable for one more task -- see its section 7. Now declares 'delivery' and originates the same class of time-boxed policy as SPRINT-2-CHARTER: budgets, gates and blackouts that expire with the sprint and are deliberately not registered as D-nnn.

Executable context for Sprint 4. Delivered M7 (Python bridge with Claude SDK) and M8 (first live agent output in-world). All 8 tasks (T0-T7, PLZG-170-177) completed. Bridge uses anthropic Python SDK; auth via setup-token OAuth. Closed 2026-08-11.

Executable context for Sprint 5. Board reconciliation (triage 49 non-Done items, clear 6 false-WIP) and doc consolidation (28 governed docs to ≤14). Housekeeping sprint — no code milestones. Jira sprint metadata is sourced from DELIVERY-COORDINATES (D-026).
Visual restatement of the tier ladder META-SPEC owns. Authoritative over nothing; if it disagrees with META-SPEC it is the bug.

Foundational onboarding reading on agile practice, for humans and agents. Explains a general methodology; specifies nothing about Plaza and originates nothing. Cite for rationale, never as law -- same standing as ALIGNED-SPEC-025.
Plain-language companion to AGILE-EXPLAINED. Same standing: authoritative over nothing.
documents.enforcement_na_reason: Plain-language companion to AGILE-EXPLAINED. General education, no claim about this repository -- checked explicitly during PLZG-136 review, which found AGILE-EXPLAINED does carry one ('Adopted as foundational onboarding reading') and rescored it asserted. This file carries no equivalent.

documents.note: Claude Code statusline protocol reference. Documents Anthropic's shipped JSON schema for statusline scripts and annotates bridge relevance per field. External protocol, asserts nothing about this repository.

documents.note: DevOps setup guide covering model routing, CI pipeline, issue triage, Claude routines, and release automation. Documents setup procedures; authoritative over nothing. State claims (job counts, file paths, labels) asserted as of last_updated.
